issue.title: Setup react, photon-kit and flux architecture
issue.body:
This PR deals with #8. Planned work:
- integration of [React](https://facebook.github.io/react/) as the front-end/rendering framework
- integration of [Photon-kit](http://photonkit.com/) using [React Photon-kit](http://react-photonkit.github.io/#/) components. 
- setting up [Flux](https://facebook.github.io/flux/) architecture to completely separate app logic from representation and rendering. 

Perhaps we can use something like [Redux](http://redux.js.org/) instead of implementing the architecture from scratch. What do you think @johndbritton @tarebyte ?

Side note: the build is going to break because of [a bug in ESLint](https://github.com/eslint/eslint/issues/6449). A fix has been made but not published.
